title: NzxterMOTD
description: This is the best and most perfect motd system for Bukkit
body:
# ✨ NzxterMOTD ✨

A modern, highly optimized, and feature-rich Message of the Day (MOTD) plugin for Bukkit/Spigot servers. Powered by **[ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)**, this plugin allows you to completely customize your server's appearance in the multiplayer server list with dynamic gradients, maintenance modes, fake player counts, and unique hover menus!

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **🌈 Dynamic Color Gradients:** Built-in advanced gradient parsing (`<green>`, `<aqua>`, `<gold>`, etc.) to create smooth, eye-catching multi-color transitions across your MOTD lines, version names, and player hover lists.
* **🔧 Smart Maintenance Mode:** Toggle maintenance with a simple command (`/motd maintenance on`). Non-staff players will see a custom maintenance MOTD, unique favicon, and will be gracefully kicked with a fully formatted message if they try to join.
* **👥 Flexible Player Count & Fake Players:** * Set a custom maximum player count independent of your `server.properties`.
  * Enable **Fake Players** to simulate active traffic with a randomized counter up to your maximum player limit.
* **🎨 Complete Server-List Customization:**
  * **Custom Version Text:** Replace the standard player count string (e.g., `1.20.4`) with customized status text, featuring alignment support for an elegant split layout.
  * **Interactive Player Hover Menu:** Fully customize the text lines displayed when players hover over the player count in their server list.
  * **Dynamic Favicons:** Automatically switch between normal and maintenance server icons (`server-icon.png`) to visually signal server status.
* **⚡ Highly Performant:** Built straight onto packet-level processing using ProtocolLib adapters, ensuring minimal impact on main server tick rates.
* **🌍 Bilingual Commands:** Support for both English (`/motd maintenance`) and German (`/motd wartung`) subcommands out of the box!

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/motd reload` | Reloads the configuration and layout variables. |
| `/motd maintenance <on\|off>` | Toggles maintenance mode status (Alias: `/motd wartung`). |
| `/motd fakeplayer <on\|off>` | Enables or disables randomized fake player display (Alias: `/motd fakespieler`). |
| `/motd max <number>` | Dynamically updates the maximum player limit. |

### 🔑 Permissions
* `motd.team` — Bypasses maintenance mode kick restriction and counts towards team player placeholders.
* `motd.bypass` — Bypasses full server connection restrictions when the maximum player count is reached.

---

## 📦 Configuration Overview

The plugin generates a detailed `config.yml` where you can customize all messages, text lists, and design templates:
* **`motd.normal.top` / `motd.normal.bottom`:** List of random MOTD phrases for standard operation.
* **`versionname.hover`:** Lines of text to display inside the interactive player list hover box.
* **`messages.maintenance.kick`:** Multi-line formatted kick screens for non-whitelisted connections.

*Note: Requires **[ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)** to be installed on your Bukkit/Spigot server instance.*
